cheap_mechanism_comparison.purpose: Decide which mechanism creates a new independent direction before any full-family search.

local_unicycle.definition: Katz-Tao four-atom molecule plus one conditionally copied leaf, glued to a heterogeneous tree over one core projection.

cheap_mechanism_comparison.decision: Expand only the dual-separated-core mechanism because it alone improved the independent-rank deficit in the pilot.

probability_legality.local_motifs: Every five-vertex coloured tree is generated by four successive conditional copies, hence every vertex has marginal U=(X,Y).
probability_legality.matched_edge_law: The endpoint pair on every edge coloured R has the same standard conditional-copy coupling of U over R, independent of the surrounding tree topology.
probability_legality.dual_interface: A Y-coloured terminal edge of the fixed path is matched to a Y-coloured edge of the heterogeneous motif. The two complete molecules are coupled conditionally independently over W=(P(first endpoint),Q(second endpoint)).

focused_family.fixed_core_edge: the unique terminal Y-coloured path edge
focused_family.heterogeneous_motifs: all 851 rooted coloured star/fork motifs from the preceding experiment
focused_family.heterogeneous_core_edges: every Y-coloured edge in each motif
focused_family.scope_limit: Other matched X-coloured path edges were sampled in the pilot but were not exhaustively screened in this focused run.

rank_exactness.consequence: Every finite-family rank, containment, reconstruction and zero-candidate decision agrees with rational linear algebra.

conclusion.result: No probability-legal 17/10 candidate in the focused dual-Y-core family.
conclusion.structural_gain: Two separated cores improved the best independent-rank deficit from three dimensions to two.
conclusion.plain_language: Unlike adding more branches to one core, the second core really contributed one new wire, but two further independent wires are still missing.
conclusion.not_claimed: This is not a no-go theorem for every dual-core interface, every matched X edge, or every entropy proof language.
conclusion.next_gate: Any further mechanism must explain how it obtains two additional independent directions without raising the total entropy cost above 17 before a larger computation is authorized.
